'''Tregg the Destroyer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] leader of Trandoshan warriors that joined [[Darth Malgus]]' [[New Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]] onboard [[Emperor's Fortress|Malgus' space station]].
